label: GO after a rewarded trial, late in the episode (trials ~55-90), when choosing a1
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2) and only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 holds 100% of mass). It is strongly gated by episode time: zero before trial ~35, rising to a peak around trials 70-79 and nearly vanishing at 90-99. 87% of the mass falls where the agent itself chooses a1 (model_act==1, choice logit strongly positive) and good==S1 (84%), and value is low-to-mid (fires at value < 7.5, never above 8.1). The strongest activations seen in the top examples are GO steps where the agent picks a1 right after a rare-rewarded visit to S1 (a2 -> S1 rewarded), i.e. a model-based switch toward a1. The predicate uses only observed variables and the upcoming choice of the agent itself (model_act). Dev: F1 0.47, mass recall 0.80, precision 0.34. Adding prev_state==1 gives F1 0.49 but lower mass recall (0.75). Precision stays low because many GO steps that are late, after reward, and choose a1 stay silent, so the feature looks like a time-in-episode-dependent code rather than a clean task variable. It does not fire after an unrewarded trial, at D1/D2, or early in the episode.
